cohort: A 40-year-old female diagnosed with endometrial adenocarcinoma grade 1 during an infertility workup.
finding: Conservative management with steady follow-up using levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine devices can be a reliable option for reproductive-age females with early-stage endometrial malignancies to achieve successful pregnancy and long-term disease-free survival.
mod_finding: Term elective C-section delivery was performed for the birth.
